summary:
quality lens over backend-observability (11 product path(s), a40b7a1..10ed46d, Codex via the autoreview skill at --max-priority P2): 1 blocking, 1 non-blocking. VERDICT t9-c1: partial — backend/src/common/global-exception.filter.ts:20 only classifies raw ZodError objects as validation failures
VERDICT t9-c2: partial — backend/src/common/structured.logger.ts:58 does not reliably sanitize frame-shaped exception message content
VERDICT t9-c3: implemented — backend/src/common/error-envelope.wiring.test.ts:18 exercises configureApp()+app.init() and proves middleware/filter wiring
LEFTOVERS: none visible in the diff.
The core observability wiring is present and tested, but validation errors can violate the standard envelope and the stack sanitizer can leak exception message content.

blocking_findings.summary: Validation HttpExceptions are emitted as generic HTTP_400 errors (backend/src/common/global-exception.filter.ts:20): The filter recognizes validation only when the thrown value itself looks like a ZodError.

t9-c1: a global exception filter (constitution 07) maps every unhandled exception and existing HttpException to the full standard error payload (errorId, type, user-facing message, sanitized details, http status, correlationId, requestId, environment, timestampUtc) and is wired app-wide via useGlobalFilters

t9-c2: structured JSON logging (constitution 05 §2.1) emits a request record and, on error, a distinct error record, each carrying timestampUtc/level/message/context/environment/serviceName/module/correlationId/accountId/requestId; correlationId accepts a valid inbound x-correlation-id else generates a UUID at ingress

non_blocking_findings.summary: Stack sanitization accepts message text disguised as a frame (backend/src/common/structured.logger.ts:58): Filtering stack lines by the `at ...:line:column` shape does not ensure they are genuine frames.

contract_verdicts.evidence: backend/src/common/global-exception.filter.ts:20 only classifies raw ZodError objects as validation failures
backend/src/common/structured.logger.ts:58 does not reliably sanitize frame-shaped exception message content
backend/src/common/error-envelope.wiring.test.ts:18 exercises configureApp()+app.init() and proves middleware/filter wiring
